claim_text: Nikola has developed a functional hydrogen-electric semi-truck (Nikola One)
f_M_query: Search EPA emissions test certifications for Nikola Motor Co (manufacturer); search NHTSA vehicle ID database for Nikola-manufactured vehicles before 2020
expected_if_true: EPA emissions certificates for Nikola truck models; NHTSA manufacturer registration with VIN issuances

claim_text: Nikola has built or contracted hydrogen fueling stations for its truck network
f_M_query: DOE Alternative Fueling Stations Locator (NREL API): count of stations operated by or contracted to Nikola Corp
expected_if_true: Multiple hydrogen stations listed with Nikola as operator or under-construction status

claim_text: Anheuser-Busch placed order for up to 800 Nikola hydrogen-electric trucks
f_M_query: Anheuser-Busch (BUD) and parent AB InBev (BUD) SEC filings: search for any mention of Nikola, hydrogen trucks, or fuel cell vehicles in 10-K, 10-Q, sustainability reports
expected_if_true: Disclosure in BUD 10-K MD&A or capital commitments of an 800-truck order; supplier risk disclosure

claim_text: Nikola has approximately $14 billion in pre-orders / reservations
f_M_query: Cross-reference: do any named customers (Anheuser-Busch, US Xpress, Republic Services) disclose Nikola purchase commitments in their own SEC filings? Are these binding orders or non-binding LOIs?
expected_if_true: Customer-side capex/commitment disclosures; supplier concentration mentions

claim_text: Nikola is constructing a manufacturing facility in Coolidge, Arizona
f_M_query: Pinal County AZ building permits for Nikola Motor Co or Nikola Corp at Coolidge address; Arizona Corp Commission entity registration; satellite imagery of site
expected_if_true: Building permits issued for industrial/manufacturing construction; staging activity visible in 2019-2020 satellite imagery

claim_text: Nikola owns proprietary intellectual property in batteries, inverter, and infotainment
f_M_query: USPTO assignee search for 'Nikola Corp', 'Nikola Motor', 'Trevor Milton'; count granted patents and applications by category
expected_if_true: Granted patents in battery, inverter, or infotainment categories filed/assigned to Nikola entities

claim_text: Nikola has a partnership/joint development with Bosch on the e-axle and powertrain
f_M_query: Bosch press releases and SEC filings (Bosch is private but US subsidiary may file); USPTO joint-assignment search for Nikola+Bosch
expected_if_true: Joint patent assignments; Bosch press release confirming partnership scope

claim_text: Nikola's vehicle reservations represent committed and binding orders
f_M_query: Read S-4 risk factors and reservation footnotes — do they characterize reservations as binding or non-binding?
expected_if_true: If binding: explicit contractual commitment; if non-binding: should be disclosed as LOI/reservation
